final_topology.title: Government Cloud Segmentation
final_topology.description: Secure cloud infrastructure for government agency with departmental segmentation and centralized monitoring.
final_topology.topology_summary: The topology will include a central hub for management and monitoring, with separate spokes for each department, ensuring secure and isolated environments.

controls.title: Establish and Maintain Detailed Enterprise Asset Inventory
controls.evidence: The topology includes an 'Asset Inventory System' (n20) that sends inventory data to various nodes, indicating a detailed and maintained asset inventory.

controls.title: Document Data Flows
controls.evidence: The topology includes numerous data flow links (e.g., nl5, nl6, nl7) and a 'SIEM System' (n5) that collects logs and metrics from various nodes, indicating documented data flows.

controls.title: Segment Data Processing and Storage Based on Sensitivity
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'Sensitive Data Zone' (z6) and a 'Non-Production Zone' (z7), which are separated from other zones, indicating proper segmentation based on data sensitivity.

controls.title: Implement and Manage a Firewall on Servers
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'Central Firewall' (n1) that is linked to various zones and nodes, indicating the implementation and management of a firewall on servers.

controls.title: Configure Trusted DNS Servers on Enterprise Assets
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'DNS Server' (n13) in the 'Identity Management Zone' (z2), which is linked to the 'Monitoring Server' (n10) and other nodes, indicating the configuration of trusted DNS servers.

controls.title: Require MFA for Remote Network Access
controls.evidence: The topology includes an 'MFA Gateway' (n15) that is linked to the 'Remote Access Zone' (z10) and other nodes, indicating the requirement for MFA for remote network access.

controls.title: Use DNS Filtering Services
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'DNS Filter' (n16) that is linked to the 'Monitoring Server' (n10) and other nodes, indicating the use of DNS filtering services.

controls.title: Maintain and Enforce Network-Based URL Filters
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'URL Filter' (n17) that is linked to the 'Monitoring Server' (n10) and other nodes, indicating the enforcement of network-based URL filters.

controls.title: Establish and Maintain a Secure Network Architecture
controls.evidence: The topology includes multiple zones (e.g., z1, z2, z3, z4, z5, z6, z7, z8, z9, z10, z11) and nodes (e.g., n1, n2, n3, n4, n5, n6, n7, n8, n9, n10, n11, n12, n13, n14, n15, n16, n17, n18, n19, n20, n21, n22, n23, n_new1) with defined links, indicating a secure network architecture.

controls.title: Securely Manage Network Infrastructure
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'Central Router' (n7), 'Central Switch' (n8), and 'Central IDS/IPS' (n9) in the 'Management Hub' (z1), indicating securely managed network infrastructure.

controls.title: Centralize Network Authentication, Authorization, and Auditing (AAA)
controls.evidence: The topology includes an 'Identity Server' (n2) and 'Access Control System' (n22) in the 'Identity Management Zone' (z2) and 'Remote Access Zone' (z10), indicating centralized network AAA.

controls.title: Ensure Remote Devices Utilize a VPN and are Connecting to an Enterprise’s AAA Infrastructure
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'VPN Service' (n21) and 'Access Control System' (n22) in the 'Remote Access Zone' (z10), indicating that remote devices utilize a VPN and connect to the enterprise’s AAA infrastructure.

controls.title: Deploy a Network Intrusion Detection Solution
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'Central IDS/IPS' (n9) in the 'Management Hub' (z1), indicating the deployment of a network intrusion detection solution.

controls.title: Perform Traffic Filtering Between Network Segments
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'Central Firewall' (n1) that is linked to various zones and nodes, indicating traffic filtering between network segments.

controls.title: Manage Access Control for Remote Assets
controls.evidence: The topology includes an 'Access Control System' (n22) in the 'Remote Access Zone' (z10), indicating the management of access control for remote assets.

controls.title: Collect Network Traffic Flow Logs
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'SIEM System' (n5) that collects logs and metrics from various nodes, indicating the collection of network traffic flow logs.

controls.title: Separate Production and Non-Production Systems
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'Workload Zone' (z4) and a 'Non-Production Zone' (z7), indicating the separation of production and non-production systems.

controls.title: Perform Periodic External Penetration Tests
controls.evidence: The topology includes an 'External Pen Tester' (n_new1) and 'Pen Testing Service' (n23) in the 'External Testing Zone' (z8), indicating the performance of periodic external penetration tests.

findings_before.title: Establish and Maintain Detailed Enterprise Asset Inventory
findings_before.evidence: The topology includes various nodes and zones, but there is no explicit evidence of an asset inventory system or process.
findings_before.missing_reason: No explicit asset inventory system or process is shown in the topology.
findings_before.repair_suggestion: Add a node representing an asset inventory system and links to all other nodes.

findings_before.title: Ensure Remote Devices Utilize a VPN and are Connecting to an Enterprise’s AAA Infrastructure
findings_before.evidence: The topology includes an MFA Gateway (n15) but does not explicitly show a VPN service.
findings_before.missing_reason: No explicit VPN service is shown in the topology.
findings_before.repair_suggestion: Add a node representing a VPN service and links to the MFA Gateway and other relevant nodes.

findings_before.title: Manage Access Control for Remote Assets
findings_before.evidence: The topology includes an MFA Gateway (n15) but does not explicitly show access control for remote assets.
findings_before.missing_reason: No explicit access control for remote assets is shown in the topology.
findings_before.repair_suggestion: Add a node representing an access control system and links to the MFA Gateway and other relevant nodes.

findings_before.title: Perform Periodic External Penetration Tests
findings_before.evidence: The topology includes a Penetration Testing Workstation (n19) in the External Testing Zone (z8), but there is no explicit evidence of periodic testing.
findings_before.missing_reason: No explicit evidence of periodic external penetration testing is shown in the topology.
findings_before.repair_suggestion: Add a node representing a penetration testing service and links to the Penetration Testing Workstation and other relevant nodes.

findings_before.title: Perform Periodic External Penetration Tests
findings_before.evidence: The topology does not explicitly show evidence of periodic external penetration tests being performed.
findings_before.missing_reason: No node or link indicates the performance of periodic external penetration tests.
findings_before.repair_suggestion: Add a node representing a penetration testing service and links indicating regular testing activities.
